verdicts.rationale: The private saved bw object has no NULL initialization or preceding pointer assignment for fobs1; the first observation read therefore queries an undefined association status at L484. Saving the object does not define that pointer status.

These spacepars fields are pointers, as generated by templates/spacedecl.mako, rather than allocatable components; allocating an already associated pointer does not produce the claimed already-allocated failure. It can abandon an old target, but that is a different issue and depends on ownership and caller cleanup.

The saved bw arrays are allocated on first use and later indexed using the current grid dimensions, with no resize path. Whether a differently sized second grid can legitimately reach this saved module requires the model initialization/finalization and reuse contract.

assim_rd reads dx, dy, nx and ny directly from the observation file and performs allocation and interpolation without validating their values. Zero spacings reach division and MOD, and dimensions below two cannot accommodate the forced index 2; the claim overstates the necessary minimum as three.

The normal parameter path restricts bedfriction to exactly the five handled selectors in params.F90 L683-L691 through parmapply. readkey.F90 L287-L312 rejects unsupported names and halts, so the absent default does not silently accept an unsupported user selector.

The unguarded initialization allocations and first-use saved work arrays are present. A supported repeated initialization or grid-size change must be established from the lifecycle contract before these storage assumptions can be accepted as a defect.

verdicts.rationale: Dry cells do not imply zero hh: initialize.F90 L1012 and flow_timestep.F90 L940 floor hh at par%eps, as does this file at L3200-L3207. The dimensionless table arguments are also clamped at L3100-L3101, so missing a wet mask alone does not establish the claimed dry-cell singularity or invalid table indices.

gw_init allocates the master space-state targets without an association check or local teardown. These are pointer components, so a second model initialization is problematic only if the external lifecycle fails to release or replace their targets; that contract is not given here.

The saved work arrays and solver sentinel preserve first-use dimensions and branch-dependent storage, while connectcrit also preserves first-use configuration. The file does not establish that a later grid, solver or head-model change is supported, so the required reuse contract is missing.

The nonhydrostatic branch evaluates 4*dt/Trep without a local denominator guard. Whether a zero or invalid Trep can reach groundwater smoothing requires the nonhydrostatic parameter and calling contracts.

Both routines compute vcr using par%D50(1) without a local positivity check. Acceptance requires evidence that the upstream grain-size contract permits zero or invalid D50 when these groundwater routines are called.

The cited frequency conversions divide directly by par%Trep or par%px, but px is the pi factor rather than another period. The file alone does not establish an invalid period or pi value reaching these routines; their parameter initialization contract is required.

The original-model branch constructs the stated reciprocal grid metrics without local checks. Whether this is a defect requires the grid-generation contract, including how the nominal y metrics are defined for one-dimensional grids.

Both y-direction vertical-viscosity fluxes multiply by hu while differencing Wm along j and using ddyv. The wetv factors on the resulting divergence do not substitute the missing V-face depth hv on wet, directionally varying bathymetry.
